newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up in speculative trade.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared on Wednesday amid speculative buying prompted by news of talks progressing between Pakistani officials and the International Monetary Fund in Washington, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 25.26 points, or 1.82 percent, to end at 1,410.69. Gainers led losers 172 to 73.
Dealers said news of progress in talks with the IMF for resumption of a stalled $600 million standby loan prompted speculators to square their short positions.
Hub Power Co rose 1.10 rupees to 31.50 and Fauji Fertilizer 1.75 to 70.50.
